widgets_values:
Referring to images 1, 2, 3, have the woman in image 1 hold the large black dildo from image 2 in her right hand and the large purple dildo from image 3 in her left hand.

She raised her hands to her sides to show the items she was holding.

Maintain consistency in character, hairstyle, and  Maintain consistency in her facial expressions.
